_comment: Illustrative entry rules for mock mode only (pairs the built-in rules don't cover). Never shown to travellers as current rules: mock mode never runs on production.

pairs.name: Schengen visa
pairs.text: {name} needs a Schengen visa from the French visa centre (TLScontact Riyadh). Appointments take about 2 weeks.
Visa on arrival in Bali, IDR 500,000, or an e-VOA online before flying.

pairs.name: Japan eVISA
pairs.text: {name} needs a Japan eVISA. It's online, about 5 working days.
A free visit visa on arrival, 30 days.

pairs.name: Türkiye visa
pairs.text: {name} needs a Türkiye visa from the consulate in Riyadh, about 15 working days (or an e-Visa with a valid US, UK or Schengen visa).

pairs.name: UAE visit visa
pairs.text: {name} needs a UAE visit visa before flying. It takes about 3 working days.

pairs.name: Azerbaijan e-Visa
pairs.text: {name} needs an Azerbaijan e-Visa. It's online, about 3 working days.

pairs.name: UK visit visa
pairs.text: {name} needs a UK visit visa. VFS Riyadh appointments take about 3 weeks.

pairs.name: UK ETA
pairs.text: {name} needs a UK ETA: online, GBP 16, usually 3 days.
{name} can't visit Georgia on this passport for tourism.
